import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    count = 1
    MOD = 1000000007
    seen = [0] * p
    offset = 1 if k == 1 else 0
    
    for i in range(offset, p):
        if seen[i]:
            continue
        cur = i
        while True:
            seen[cur] = 1
            cur = (cur * k) % p
            if cur == i or cur == 0:
                break
        count = (count * p) % MOD
    
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
